svg.font-family: Hanken Grotesk, Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A card of the four capabilities gather can be asked for. fetch is always served by the stdlib. fast-parse falls back to the stdlib parser, which returns the same answer more slowly. js-render and stealth are refused with a reason when no backend is installed, and the js-render row is marked because it is the one where a plausible fake exists.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: INSTALL A BACKEND, OR BE TOLD YOU DID NOT
What serves each capability, and what happens when nothing does

g.text: Refused the same way. A request that needed browser
impersonation is reported unmet, not answered plainly.

svg.text: The refusal is a result object, not an exception: status UNVERIFIABLE, the capability asked for, and a reason reading no backend for capability
js-render. It carries no html and no content hash, so nothing downstream mistakes it for a page that was fetched. Which backends are installed differs
by machine, so this draws the absent case, which is the same everywhere. Refusing honestly says nothing about how well an installed backend
